catchphrase.夏だよ、ご主人さまっ！\nクルルと一緒にたっっくさん遊ぼうね♪:
Summer is here, Master!
Let’s have enough fun with Kururu♪
catchphrase.夏バテ、熱中症対策は、\nこの水着メイド・ニナにお任せください:
Prevent summer fatigue and heatstroke,
Please leave it to the swimsuit maid Nina
catchphrase.うん。いい回転音……\nこれだからドリルはたまらない:
Um. What a wonderful spinning sound...
That’s why drills are so addictive.
catchphrase.お姉ちゃんと一緒ならわたしは、\nどんな場所でも、どんな相手でも負けない。:
As long as I'm with my sister,
No matter where I am or who I face, I will never lose.
catchphrase.お店の一番人気、ベリーのタルトを\n召し上がれ！:
Enjoy the shop's most popular berry tart 
!
catchphrase.ご主人様の指示は絶対。エレクトラは\n如何なる命令にも対応します:
The master's instructions are categorical imperatives. Elektra
Any command will be executed.
catchphrase.さあいくわよ、ノワール！\n私たちの力、みんなに見せてあげましょう！:
Come on, Noir!
Let everyone see our power!
catchphrase.ずっと思い続けてきたのですから\n私と添い遂げてくれますよね？:
I've been thinking of you,
So you will stay with me for life, right?
catchphrase.だから子どもじゃないって！\nあたしの刀の錆にされたいの？:
I told you I'm not a child!
Do you want to become the rust on my knife?
catchphrase.はいどうもーっ、ピコにゃんでーす！\nいま異世界に来てまーす！:
Hello everyone, I am Pi Ke Meow!
Now we come to another world!
catchphrase.ふふふ、今日の占いはバッチリです！ \n良い結果が出ましたよ！:
Hahaha, today’s divination is very accurate!
The result is very good!
catchphrase.ふふふっ！ やはり私は天才！\n最高の発明品が完成しそうだ……:
Hahaha! I am indeed a genius!
The best invention is almost done...
catchphrase.よいしょー！\n水の精霊パワー炸裂ぅ！:
Hey!
The power of the water elf explodes!
catchphrase.エミリースマイルでお客さんを幸せにしちゃいますよ！: I want to make my guests happy with my Emily smile!
catchphrase.マニョは寂しくないよ……\nだってマックンがいるもん:
Manio is not lonely...
Because Xiaoma is here.
catchphrase.一番槍はアタシの役目だよっ！\nみんな、アタシに続いてくれ！:
It’s my duty to lead the charge!
Everyone, follow me!
catchphrase.何でも頼むといい。\n私は君たち人間が大好きだからな。:
You can ask me for anything.
Because I like you humans the most.
catchphrase.小鳥さんたちって、いつも自由に\n飛んでて楽しそうですね♪:
The birds are always free
Flying around, it looks so happy♪
catchphrase.手際よく、無駄なくが\nわたくしのモットーです:
The movements are neat and without waste,
This is my creed.
catchphrase.星空は航海図！ 風は友達！\nどんな嵐だって乗り越えて見せるさ！:
The starry sky is a nautical chart! The wind is a friend!
No matter what kind of storm, I will step over to show you!
catchphrase.狙った標的は逃しません\nわたしにできるのはそのくらいだし……:
The target you aim at will never let go.
After all, that's all I can do...
catchphrase.狩りの相棒がほしかったんでしょ？ \nボクが付き合ってあげる:
Don't you want a hunting partner?
I'll accompany you.
catchphrase.目、離さないでよね\nうちのダンスに酔いしれなさい♪:
Don't look away.
Get lost in my dancing♪
catchphrase.目指せ一攫千金！\nお宝はどこにあるかなぁ～？:
The goal is to get rich overnight!
Where will the treasure be~?
catchphrase.私が信じるのは、ただ炎と\nこの矢だけ。さあ、焼き尽くそう:
All I believe in is fire
and this arrow. Come on, burn them all.
catchphrase.美しき氷像をご覧に入れましょう。\nあなたには理解できないかもだけれど。:
Please enjoy this beautiful ice sculpture.
Although you may not understand its beauty.
catchphrase.見たことない素材、知らない技術……\nくぅぅ～、最高にわくわくするなぁ！:
Unseen materials, unknown technology...
Uh-oh~ It’s so exciting!
catchphrase.魔法の力は無限大です！: The power of magic is unlimited!
catchphrase.ちゃんとできたら\nよしよししてくれますか？:
If I finish it well,
Can you pat me on the head and praise me?
catchphrase.今日からオレがお前らを導いてやる！\nしっかり働けよ！:

and act accordingly.

Hey hey... I can be with Miss Vera,
Miss Belissa prepares together,
So happy♪
serif.ふふ……\n次は、わたしとお姉ちゃんの\n再会パーティーもしなくっちゃ♪:
Haha...
I have to do one next time
It’s just a reunion party for my sister and I♪
serif.ふふ。サプライズにしないと、\n司令官さまは恥ずかしがって、\n逃げちゃいそうで:
hehe. If it's not a surprise,
The Commander will definitely be shy.
Then you ran away~
serif.もう、お姉ちゃんったら。\nウェンディさんを喜ばせたいって\n素直に言えばいいの:
Now that I have a sister.
I want to please Wendy.
I wish I could just be honest...hehe
serif.ウェンディさん、\nとっても嬉しそう……\nえへへ、やったねお姉ちゃん♪:
Miss Wendy,
Looks really happy...
Hehehe, it worked, sister♪
serif.ウェンディさん、とっても\n張り切ってる……わたしたちも\n頑張ろうね、お姉ちゃ:
Wendy-san is really enthusiastic 
... Let's do our best 
 too, sister♪
serif.ウェンディさんのためにも、\n必ずサプライズパーティーを\n成功させてみせます…:
For Miss Wendy,
I will definitely make this surprise party
A complete success...!
serif.サプライズパーティー……\n司令官、喜んでくれると\nいいなぁ～:
Surprise party…
If the commander can be happy,
That would be great~
serif.ヴィーラさん、ベリサさん……\nお二人が友だちでいてくれて、\nわたし、本当に幸:
Miss Vera, Miss Belisa...
To have friends like you two,
I'm so happy.
serif.ヴィーラさん、ベリサさん、\n本当にありがとうござます！\n大好きです♪:
Miss Vera, Miss Belissa,
Thank you very much!
I like you the most♪
serif.友情の力は無限大です……！\nぱわぁぁぁぁぁあああ！！！！:
The power of friendship is infinite...!
Power - strength - full - open! ! ! !
serif.司令官に喜んでもらえました～！\nサプライズ、大成功です♪:
The commander is very happy~!
Surprise and great success♪
serif.ありがとうございます、旦那様。\n鬼族と人が仲良くなれる日が\n来るなんて……夢:
Thank you, husband.
The day when ghosts and humans can coexist in harmony
It actually came... It was like a dream!
serif.それでは鬼族のみんな……！\n次は旦那様とシラエスママを\nもてなしますよ～♪:
So, everyone from the ghost clan...!
Next, treat your husband well
With Sheila Aisi’s mother~♪
serif.ふふ、クレハ君はいい子だな。\n時間をかけて仲良くなろう……\n１０年くらい……:
Haha, Hongye is such a good boy.
Take your time and spend time getting along...
Ten years or so...isn't that too long?
serif.ふふ、人間と同じくらい\n鬼族のみんなを大好きになったよ:
Haha, I already like human beings,
I have fallen deeply in love with all the ghost clan members.
serif.みんな張り切っているね……\n私も、精一杯盛り上げるとしよう。\nあ、よいしょよ:
Everyone is very motivated...
I'm going to do my best to be lively too.
Ah, hey hey hey.
serif.サクラ役なら任せてほしい。\n伊達に歳を重ねてないからな。\n演技には自信がある:
Leave the role of sitter to me.
All these years have not been in vain.
I am very confident in my acting skills.
serif.ソフィアが信頼する人物……\nその手並み拝見させてもらうぞ:
Someone whom Sophia trusts...
Just show me what you're capable of.
serif.仲人になっていただき、\n感謝しますシラエスさん……\nいえ、シラエスママ！:
Thank you for connecting us,
Miss Sheila Ais...
No, it’s Mama Sheila Ais!
serif.大穴で産出される武具は\nミレスガルドの戦力強化に有益\n優先的に買い取らせて欲:
Weapons found in large caves
It is very useful to strengthen Miresgard's combat power.
Hope to get priority.
serif.旦那様が私と一緒に鬼ヶ島へ\n里帰りしてくださるのですか！？\nもしや結婚の挨拶:
Husband wants to be with me
Are you going back to Onigashima to visit relatives? ?
Could it be for wedding greetings! ?
serif.旦那様～♪ 観光客のみなさまに\nお出しする料理ができました♪\n味見してくださ:
Husband~♪ For tourists
The food is ready♪
Please try it, ah~hmm♪
serif.王都の防衛で手が離せぬ今、\n前線の指揮は\nあの男に任せるしかない、か……:
Nowadays, the defense of the royal capital is ineffective.
frontline command
Can I just leave it to that man...
serif.私と旦那の愛のパワーで、\n必ずや鬼ヶ島のプロデュースを\n成功させてみせます！:
With the power of my husband and I’s love,
Must let Onigashima's planner
A huge success!
serif.鬼ヶ島、か……\n千年以上冒険者をやっていたが、\n行くのは初めてだよ。楽しみだ:
Ghost Island...
Having been an adventurer for more than a thousand years,
This is my first time going. Really looking forward to it.
serif.鬼ヶ島での出来事は、\n何千年経とうが色褪せない、\n素晴らしい思い出だよ:
Everything that happened on Ghost Island,
It will not fade no matter how many thousands of years pass.
Those are extremely precious memories.

name.オーバーリミット・真: Break through the limits and be true

effect_text.「箱の外には絶望しかない」そう口にした瞬間「ソウダ」という声と共に\n 何者かが:
The moment he said "There is only despair outside the box", he was accompanied by a "Yes",
A certain existence is coming!
effect_text.あえて光の届かない瘴気の霧の中を進む。\n 揺らめく炎の中に、笑っている顔が見え:
The exploration team deliberately walked into the miasma where the light could not reach.
In the swaying flames, a smiling face seemed to be seen.
effect_text.あまりに怪しすぎる存在に調査すら諦めるが、周囲の立地は見晴らしもよく休息に適して:
The existence was so suspicious that the exploration team even gave up investigating, but the surrounding terrain was open and very suitable for rest.
They left minimal surveillance, the treasure chest did not change, and everyone was able to rest slowly.
effect_text.あまりの渇きにジョッキの中身をあおると、爽やかな喉越しと爽快感が押し寄せる。\n:
After being thirsty, I drank the contents of the large cup in one gulp, and the refreshing taste and pleasure came over me.
Everyone couldn't help but make a sound, but then they were attacked by severe abdominal pain.
Especially in a large cave, you must not be led away by desire.
effect_text.いくつかの物資が残されているのを発見した。\n 同じくこの先を目指した探索者のも:
The exploration team discovered that several supplies had been left behind.
Was it left by explorers who also aimed at this front?
Just use it gratefully.
effect_text.いくらかの物資を置いて、瘴気の霧の届かない高台へと登る。\n下よりはやや清浄な空:

effect_text.薄い瘴気の霧の中、しばし拾った木の枝でじゃれていたが、小動物はどこかへと去ってい:
In the thin miasma, the exploration team played with the small animal for a while with the branches they picked up, and then it went elsewhere.
When we were about to move on, we noticed branches and an unfamiliar object on our luggage.
Is this their way of expressing friendship?
effect_text.虫柱もいつまでもそこにいるわけではない。\n注視しつつ簡単に食事を摂っている間に:
The swarm doesn't stay there forever, either.
While staring at them, he had a simple meal. When he came back to his senses, the sound of insect wings could no longer be heard.
effect_text.行き詰る大穴の中での突然の日光浴に、皆の緊張がほころんでいくのがわかる。\n光の:
Suddenly exposed to sunlight in the large, desperate cave, everyone's tension gradually eased.
The light source was so dazzling that it was impossible to confirm its source, as if the ceiling was cut open only there.
effect_text.襲撃に備え、四方を警戒し円陣を組む。\nしかし、唸り声は瘴気の霧に紛れいつの間に:
In order to prepare for the attack, everyone was on alert in all directions and formed a circular formation.
However, the low roar was mixed into the miasma, and I didn't know when I couldn't hear it anymore...
effect_text.襲撃を警戒し周囲を探索していると、瘴気の霧の中に何かを発見した。\nこちらも警戒:
While alerting the raid and exploring the surroundings, the expedition team discovered something in the miasma.
We also remain vigilant here and sneak into the miasma to investigate. There is a treasure box placed there...
effect_text.要らぬ諍いを避けるため、野営地から離れた場所で休息することにした。\n沁み込んで:
In order to avoid unnecessary disputes, the exploration team decided to rest far away from the camp.
While he was surrounded by a miasma that seemed to seep into his body, he discovered a giant tree in the darkness.
In order not to let the following teams go in vain, raise the marking flag.
effect_text.見た目よりも険しい崖を上り、傷だらけになりながら巣へと侵入を果たす。\n光ってい:
They scaled cliffs that were steeper than they appeared, and broke into the lair covered in scars.
The glowing thing is a key with an unknown purpose.
But there was no time to think, because in order to leave the nest, one had to climb down the cliff just now.
effect_text.見張り塔の上から周囲の地形を確認していると、瘴気の霧の薄い場所を発見する。\n多:
When checking the surrounding terrain from the observation tower, I discovered a place where the miasma was thin.
Even though it was a slightly detour, the expedition decided to take that route and noted it on the map.
effect_text.見張り塔の脇に旗を掲げるためのポールを発見した。\n後続隊のために、前線基地の旗:
The expedition team discovered the pole used for raising the flag next to the watchtower.
They hoisted the forward base flag for the following teams.
effect_text.解錠が中途半端なせいかもしれない。\n鍵に手をかけると同時に、鍵穴から漆黒の瘴気:
Maybe it's because the lock was not opened thoroughly.
When he reached out and touched the key, pitch-black miasma sprayed out from the keyhole.
After the fog dissipated, the door was wide open, and the dimly glowing key was held in his hand without knowing when.
effect_text.試しに鈴を手にすると、チーンとすんだ金属音が響く。\n その瞬間、目の前に忽然と:
After trying to pick up the bell, a clear metallic sound rang out.
The next moment, the monster suddenly appeared in front of you!
effect_text.誰かが、それこそ命がけで運んできた物資だ。\nみすみすモンスターに渡すわけにはい:
This is material that someone even risked their own life to bring in.
We can't just let the monster take it away.
After we launched a surprise attack, the monsters fled.
effect_text.誰が教えてくれたかはわからないが、貴重な水場だ。\n洞窟は深入りせず警戒だけとし:
Although we don’t know who guided us, this is a precious water source.
The exploration team did not go deep into the cave. They only remained vigilant and everyone rested together.
effect_text.誰見ていないならちょうどいい。\n 商品を盗もうと手に取った瞬間、金属製の鼠罠が:
It's fine if no one sees it.
The moment he reached out to pick up the product as he was about to steal it, a metal mousetrap caught his finger.
It seems that although this stall owner is not good at business, he has a high sense of anti-theft...
effect_text.警戒はしつつ、戦いの準備をする。\n 向こうも準備は万全のようだ。\n いざ、尋:
Stay alert and prepare for battle.
The other party seemed to be well prepared.
Come on, let's fight it out in an upright manner.
effect_text.足を滑らせないように、ゆっくりと歩を進める。\n 渡りきるころにはすっかりと瘴気:
In order to avoid slipping under their feet, the exploration team moved forward slowly.
By the time he got through, he had already inhaled a large amount of miasma mist.
effect_text.身一つで崖を登ってきた彼らに帰還用の物資を分け与える。\n大穴探索は懲りたという:
The expedition team distributed supplies for the return trip to those who climbed the cliff almost with their bare hands.
The group expressed that they had had enough of exploring the Great Cave and handed over an item they said they had obtained from a treasure chest as a thank you gift.
effect_text.軒先を借りて、しばらく休息をとることにした。\n向こうも人数が多い方がモンスター:
The exploration team borrowed the eaves and rested for a while.
The other party probably also understands that monsters can be avoided with more people.
They did not complain and silently approved our actions.
effect_text.逃げる必要もない。\n 皆で武器を構え、敵を迎え撃つ。:
There is no need to run away.
Everyone raised their weapons and faced the enemy.
effect_text.通り抜けるにはいくつかの物資を置いていく必要があった。\n結果として身軽になった:
To get through here, you must leave a few supplies behind.
As a result, after the burden was relieved, the exploration team's pace became brisk and they continued to move forward.
effect_text.進行の邪魔になる物資を河原に残置し。川を渡る。\n互いの身体をロープで繋ぎ、何と:
The exploration team left the materials that would hinder their progress on the river beach and crossed the river.
Everyone connected each other with ropes and finally successfully crossed the river.
They left ropes for the following teams to cross the river and moved on.
effect_text.道を外れた場所に身を潜め、人影が足り去るのを待つ。\nしばらくして待った後、彼ら:
The exploration team hid away from the road and waited for the figure to leave.
After waiting for a while, they checked where the people were and found several relics.
effect_text.違法に大穴に入るということは、全てが自己責任だ。\n助けに入って二重遭難という事:
Entering the cave illegally means doing so at your own risk.
There are also many cases where rescue efforts failed and resulted in secondary deaths. The exploration team mixed into the miasma and continued to move forward.
The sound of fighting continued behind the scenes. At least hopefully they can hold on until we get through.
effect_text.違法探索者たちと取引をし、こちらの物資と引き換えに野営地で休めることになった。\:
The exploration team traded with illegal explorers, exchanging our supplies for the opportunity to rest in the camp.
They are no longer able to challenge the enemy in front, so they are parasitically trying to get a piece of the pie.
effect_text.遺体を埋葬しようと穴を掘っていると、豪華な宝箱を発見した。\n 彼か彼女からの贈:
While the expedition team was digging a hole to bury the remains, they discovered a luxurious treasure chest.
It may be a gift from him or her. After burying the body solemnly, accept the contents of the box.
effect_text.重力に逆らわずに、荷物と共に滑り落ちる。\n 坂の下は流れ込んできた瘴気の霧が溜:
The exploration team did not defy gravity and slid down with their luggage.
The inflowing miasma mist accumulated under the slope, but everyone was not injured and managed to stand up.
We must recover materials and leave here as soon as possible.
effect_text.野営候補地とは言え、あくまで比較的安全というだけの場所だ。\n多少の侵食を覚悟し:
Although it is a camping candidate, it is only a relatively safe place.
The exploration team was prepared to be somewhat eroded and took their final rest in the miasma.
effect_text.野営地で焚火を起こし、残されていた保存食をもらうことにした。\n 久しぶりの温か:
The expedition team built a bonfire at the camp and enjoyed the preserved food left behind.
The long-awaited warm food restores your strength.
Okay, let’s work harder.
effect_text.野営地の防衛用に塹壕を掘っていると、堅牢な宝箱を発掘した。\n この階層の戦利品:
While digging trenches to defend the camp, the expedition unearthed a sturdy treasure chest.
Just accept it with gratitude as the spoils of this class.
effect_text.鍵のかかっていない扉を開ける。\n 案の定、目の前には敵が待ち構えていた！:
The exploration team opens the unlocked door.
Sure enough, the enemy is waiting in front of you!
effect_text.鍵穴は、ちょうどコインが入るくらいの大きさだった。\n誤作動を願って手持ちのコイ:
The keyhole is just the right size to fit a coin.
The exploration team prayed for a mistake and threw in the coins one by one.
Just when there were only a few coins left in his hand, the door lock broke and the city gate began to open...
effect_text.鍵穴を覗き込んでみると真っ暗な穴の中で何かがヌラリと光を反射している。\nじっと:
After peeking into the keyhole, I saw something glisteningly reflecting light in the dark hole.
Take a closer look... There is also a certain existence's eyeballs on the other side staring at this side.
Suddenly, black miasma sprayed out from the keyhole, and the city gate opened.
effect_text.関わり合いになる必要もないだろう。\n瘴気の霧に紛れ、先を進む。\n一応、後続隊:
No need to get involved.
The exploration team mixed into the miasma and continued to move forward.
In order to prevent subsequent teams from being involved, marks were carved on the ground.
effect_text.隙間を通らない荷物を捨てねじ込むようにして門をくぐる。\n見ると、城門の巨大な蝶:
The exploration team dropped their luggage that couldn't fit through the gap and squeezed through the door.
When he took a look, he found something caught in the huge hinge part of the city gate.
It was something so valuable that one couldn't understand why it would appear in a place like this. Make sure first.
effect_text.障害物を除去中に襲われたら面倒だ。\n あえて危険を冒す必要はないと判断した探索:
It would be troublesome if you were attacked while clearing obstacles.
The exploration team judged that there was no need to deliberately take risks, and endured fatigue and took another path.
effect_text.霧の発生源を探すため急いで前方の丘へと向かうと、霧を発する怪しい結晶を発見した。:
In order to find the source of the fog, the exploration team hurried to the hills ahead and found suspicious crystals emitting fog.
After destroying the crystal, something fell down.
effect_text.露店の周囲を見て回る。\n 瘴気の霧の中に隠れていた看板はかなりの高さがある。\:
The exploration team looked around the stall.
The signboard hidden in the miasma is quite tall.
Let's use it as a mark for the following teams.
effect_text.音を頼りに進んでいくと、見晴らしの良い場所へと出た。\n 周囲にはなにもなく、た:
After following the sound, we came to a place with a wide view.
There was nothing around, just surrounded by a faint miasma.
effect_text.音を頼りに進んでいくと、見晴らしの良い場所へと出た。\n周囲を見回しても演奏者ら:
After following the sound, we came to a place with a wide view.
Although I couldn’t find any performers when I looked around, I was able to set a mark for the following teams.
effect_text.高台へと登り、前線基地の旗を立てる。今はここが我々の最前線だ。\n これで後続隊:
The exploration team climbed to the high ground and raised the flag of the forward base. This is our front line now.
This way, subsequent teams won’t have to worry about the route.
effect_text.鬨の声を上げ、モンスターを威嚇しながら全速力で駆け抜ける。\n幸いモンスターたち:
The exploration team let out a war cry, intimidating the monsters while charging past at full speed.
Fortunately, the monsters prioritized guarding the lair and did not catch up.
effect_text.魔法の基礎訓練でやるように箱に魔力を流すと、カチリという音と共に箱の底板が外れる:
After injecting magic into the box like in basic magic training, the bottom plate of the box fell off with a click.
Hidden spaces contain items of incredible value.
Just accept it gratefully.
effect_text.あまりに普通の無人販売所すぎて、逆に異常だ。\n体力の消耗は無視して全速力でこの:
This unmanned store is so ordinary that it seems unusual.
The exploration team ignored the physical exertion and tried to leave the place at full speed, but it seemed that it was too late.
effect_text.このまま抜け出せないのではという妄想を振り払い、あえて険しい道を進む。\n気が付:
The exploration team put aside the delusion that they might never be able to escape, and deliberately chose a dangerous path to move forward.
When he came back to his senses, he was surrounded by swarms of monsters.
effect_text.何かしらの攻撃かもしれない。そう判断した探索隊は先を急ぐことにした。\n しばら:
This may be some kind of attack. The exploration team made a judgment and decided to speed up the pace.
 After moving forward at full speed for a while, it seemed that we could only escape here.
effect_text.全員で物資が落ちないように抑えこむ。\nその代償に転倒と物資の下敷きでいくばくか:
Everyone worked together to hold down the supplies to prevent them from falling.
The cost is that someone fell down and was crushed by the materials, but this can only be regarded as a necessary loss.
effect_text.多少の異臭は耐えられるが、火山性のガスにだけは注意が必要だ。\n装備越しにも火傷:
Some odors are tolerable, but special precautions must be taken against volcanic gases.
In a hot environment where even the equipment would be burned, the exploration team moved forward as if they were running away...
effect_text.幸い、炎のおかげで周囲の闇と瘴気の霧が祓われている。\nその横を軽くあぶられなが:
Fortunately, the flames dispersed the surrounding darkness and miasmatic fog.
The exploration team endured the scorching flames and was about to pass through, but they were attacked by something!
effect_text.後ろを振り返る余裕はない。\n探索隊は全速力でその場を離脱したが追いつかれてしま:
There is no energy left to look back.
The exploration team evacuated this place at full speed, but was still caught up.
effect_text.気にせず進んでいると、突然油が発火した。\nなんとか延焼前に通り抜けたが、煙でモ:
The exploration team continued moving forward unfazed, but the oil suddenly burned.
Although he managed to get through before the fire spread, it seemed that he was discovered by the monster due to the thick smoke.

description.\n今回の目的である探索地点が近いが、周囲に野営に適した場所が見つからない。\n:
This time's purpose is to search nearby, but I can't find a suitable place to camp nearby. 
 Whether it's physical strength, energy, or supplies... some conditions will have to be compromised.
description.こちらを観察している大型の野生動物の群れを発見した。\n前方の見晴らしの良い場所:
Found a group of large wild animals observing here
The way they look around in a wide field of vision ahead
Even like a hunter looking for prey
description.こちらを観察している大型の野生動物を発見した。\n前方の見晴らしの良い場所で周囲:
Found a large wild animal that was observing here
The way it looks around in a wide field of vision ahead
Even like a jailer watching the prisoners
description.どうやらこの階層の踏破も目前のようだ。\nしかし、この探索隊は気をゆるめることな:
It seems that we are not far away from breaking through this class.
However, this exploration team still did not relax and did not forget to be vigilant while setting up camp.
It is at times like this that you can be a good explorer by tightening your mind.
description.どこからか、奇妙な音楽が聞こえる。\n耳を澄まさなければ聞き取れないほどの音量だ:
Wonderful music came from nowhere
The volume was so low that you had to listen carefully to hear it clearly, but everyone in the team seemed to have heard it.
It was obviously the first time I heard it, and I couldn’t even tell what instruments were used.
But it is inexplicably nostalgic, and when listening to it, I feel a touch of sadness similar to nostalgia.
description.どこからか、獣の唸り声が聞こえてくる。\n野生動物の縄張りに入ってしまったのだろ:
From somewhere, I hear the roar of a beast. 
Have I entered a wild animal's territory?
description.どこからか助けを呼ぶ声が聞こえる。\n調べに行くと、小さな崖の下に滑落した違法探:
A cry for help came from nowhere.
After going to investigate, we found that a team of illegal explorers had slipped under a small cliff.
After noticing us, they offered to thank us in exchange for help.
description.どこから微かに音楽が聞こえてくる。\n物悲しい旋律と音色は、不安をかきたてるもの:
Faint music came from somewhere
The sad melody and timbre are disturbing, but lingering in the ears.
description.まるで投降するかのように両腕を挙げた奇妙なモンスターが現れた。\n妙に人間らしい:
A fantastic monster raises its arms as if surrendering
The monster moves inexplicably like a human. Although it cannot speak, it tries to communicate with a pen.
It seems that it was originally a human, but when it came back to consciousness in the large cave, it turned into a monster.
description.エルドラーナの紋章が刻まれた瀟洒な物資箱を発見した。\n機能美に溢れたその箱は中:

description.アーデルハイトから呼び出された主人公たちが見せられたのは、大海原の写真。なぜこん: What the protagonist and his party called by Adelheid saw was a photo of the vast ocean. Facing the people who were confused as to why they were shown such a photo, Adelheid said: "This is a photo sent back by an observation balloon used to investigate a large cave." There is an ocean in the large cave. Faced with this abnormal situation, the protagonist has increased his vigilance, but it seems that some people are not nervous at all...
description.ヒマリとヘイリーをさらった相手をセイレーンと特定した一行は、ホノカの作ったイカダ: After confirming that the opponent who kidnapped Hikari and Hailey was a siren, the group arrived at Skull Rock on a raft made by Honoka. They stepped into the interior of Skull Rock, passed through a strange cave covered in resonating kelp, and finally came to an open space. There, what they saw was Hailey and Himawari being tied up...!
description.ビーチへと帰還し、バーベキューを楽しむ一行。和気あいあいとする部下たちに、自然と: The group returned to the beach and enjoyed a barbecue. Seeing his subordinates enjoying themselves happily, a smile naturally appeared on the protagonist's face. At this time Nina comes to the protagonist. She seems to have something to say...?
description.ホノカとエアリエルまでもがレゾナンス・ケルプに囚われた。絶体絶命の危機に、偶然足: Even Honoka and Ariel were caught by the resonance kelp. When her life was hanging by a thread, a small bottle accidentally rolled to her feet...it was the super spicy Devil's Habanero chili sauce prepared by Honoka! Seeing it, the protagonist shouts "This is it!" and hatches a plan. Can the super-spicy Devil's Habanero Chili Sauce be the trick that turns the tide! ?
description.大穴の新階層に到達した主人公一行。目の前に広がる大海原と青い空に興奮を隠せない一: The protagonist and his party arrive at a new level in the large cave. Facing the vast sea and blue sky in front of them, everyone could not hide their excitement. The protagonist decided to let everyone move freely and take a rest. Beach volleyball, sunbathing, barbecue, the subordinates enjoyed their own time, and the protagonist gradually relaxed.
description.未踏階層の探索へ望むことになった一行。そのために、まずは物資の準備と探索メンバー: The group is about to explore an uncharted level. To do this, they first began to prepare supplies and select members for the expedition. Some members heard that it was the ocean and only wanted to play, which made the protagonist feel worried. However, everyone still stepped into the new level. What exactly will the protagonist and his party see there...?
description.海で競争するクルルとヘイリー。競争は白熱するが、クルルはふと奇妙なものを目にする: Kururu and Hailey race in the ocean. As the competition intensified, Kururu suddenly saw something strange: a rock protruding from the sea, and a figure sitting on it. Meanwhile, Nina and Himawari are playing beach volleyball on the shore. After the ball rolled to the rock, Sunflower went to look for it, but...
description.謎の昏睡状態から目を覚ました主人公たち。さっきの歌は何か？ そしてヒマリとヘイリ: The protagonist and his party wake up from a mysterious slumber. What was that song just now? What happened to Sunflower and Hailey... In order to find out the truth, everyone began to look for clues. The half-human and half-fish figure that Kurulu saw on the reef, the traces left on the beach ball, the mysterious singing last night... the group of people gradually approached the truth of the incident.
description.研究所に呼び出されたフィオナとクリスティはアーデルハイトの開発した新たな訓練用の: Fiona and Christie were called to the institute and asked to provide data for a new training device developed by Adelheid. Christie decided whether to participate through divination and chose to provide assistance, so he and Fiona, who had been enthusiastic from the beginning, challenged the training device "Mirror Corridor".
description.自分たちのデータに苦戦するフィオナとクリスティだが主人公の言葉に奮起し、協力して: Fiona and Christie struggled against opponents generated from their own data, but with the encouragement of the protagonist, they cheered up and won together.
description.ウェンディを荷車に乗せ、大穴を進むベリサとヴィーラ。しかし、その行く手を大穴の脅: Belissa and Vera put Wendy on the carriage and drove through the large cave. However, the threat of a large cave blocks their way. Facing the desperate situation of being outnumbered, Belisa and the others fell into crisis. Wendy was annoyed at her inability to do anything. "Someone, come and save me——!" Can Wendy's sincere prayer be conveyed...?
description.主人公のためにサプライズパーティーを開きたいウェンディ。ベリサとヴィーラの姉妹に: Wendy wants to throw a surprise party for the protagonist. She consulted with sisters Belissa and Vera, who readily agreed to help. So, the three of them started preparing for the party in harmony. So, can the party go smoothly?
description.仲間の後押しを受け、大穴内を駆け抜けるウェンディたち。その先に、目的の巨大魔力結: With the encouragement of her friends, Wendy and her group walked through the large cave. Ahead, they found their target - a huge magic crystal. However, the surrounding area is home to hordes of monsters. Exhausted from the continuous fighting, Belisa and Vera were gradually forced into a desperate situation. At this moment, Wendy had an unprecedented strong thought in her mind——
description.回復したウェンディと共に地上へ戻ってきた一行。主人公が帰ってくる前に準備を。そう: The group returned to the ground with the recovered Wendy. Just when I was thinking about getting ready before the protagonist came back, he actually showed up. Can we successfully hold a surprise party and make the protagonist happy——
description.大穴探索を通し、ウェンディは兵士たちの輪の中に馴染んでいた。すると、兵士たちから: Through the exploration of the large cave, Wendy gradually integrated into the circle of soldiers. As a result, she was invited by the soldiers to attend the birthday party of her companions. There, Wendy learned for the first time that parties were held to celebrate and reward someone. And when she learned that the protagonist’s arrival party had not yet been held——
description.症状が治ったのもつかの間、今度はネコのような言葉遣いになってしまったウェンディ。: The symptoms had just been cured, and this time Wendy spoke in a cat-like tone. Taking this as an opportunity, various strange symptoms appeared one after another. "We can't prepare for the party if this goes on!" Belisa and Vera ran around in the forward base in order to calm Wendy's symptoms.
description.突然きちんと喋ることができなくなったウェンディを直すべく、科学者であるアーデルハ: In order to repair Wendy who was suddenly unable to speak properly, the group went to seek help from scientist Adelheid. The results of the inspection showed that Wendy's magic furnace malfunctioned due to overwork. Moreover, Wendy’s symptoms seem a little unusual...?
description.魔導炉の異常が進行し、倒れてしまったウェンディ。アーデルハイトの見立てでは、大穴: Wendy's magical furnace became abnormally intensified and collapsed. According to Adelheid's diagnosis, the large magic crystals deep in the cave may be able to repair the malfunction of the magic furnace. But this requires taking an out-of-shape Wendy into a large cave. Faced with such a dangerous quest, the three girls——
description.エルフのシラエスと共に、虹色に輝くクリスタルの回収任務を終えた主人公。モンスター: The protagonist and the elf Shielais jointly completed the task of recovering the crystal that shines with colorful light. In order to be comquested to analyze this dangerous crystal that has the power to attract monsters, the two are going to Adeleheit's research institute. However, behind the two of them, there was a suspicious figure waiting for an opportunity to take advantage of their carelessness...
description.クリスタルの力で集まってきたモンスターを撃破した主人公とシラエス。２人はクリスタ: The protagonist and Shilais defeated the monster attracted by the power of the crystal. In order to track the whereabouts of the crystal, the two asked Adeleheit for help. With the help of science and technology from the other world Luxnova, they successfully locked the whereabouts of the crystal. However, the confirmed location of the crystal is actually the "Ghost Island" in the remote Penglai land...!
description.クリスタルを追って訪れた鬼ヶ島にて、荒々しい鬼族と出くわす主人公一行。このまま揉: After pursuing the crystal and arriving at the Ghost Island, the protagonist and his party encountered a group of rugged ghosts. Just when I thought there would be a conflict... I didn't expect that the ghost clan seemed to be concerned about everyone's safety. With Hongye's mediation, the group was welcomed into Onigashima and successfully recovered the crystal. However, there seemed to be a little regret on the face of the ghost clan who handed over the crystal...?
description.主人公の指揮のもと、モンスターの大群と真っ向からぶつかる鬼族たち。巧みな指揮と鬼: Under the command of the protagonist, the ghosts faced off against a large group of monsters. With clever command and the fierce fighting of the ghosts, the group of people defeated the monsters. However, under the influence of the power of the crystal, monsters continue to emerge. Seeing that the ghosts are getting exhausted, the protagonist decides to make a big gamble...!
description.鬼ヶ島をプロデュースするため、鬼ヶ島の売りとなるものを探し始める主人公。しかし、: In order to plan the promotion of Onigashima, the protagonist begins to look for selling points that Onigashima can create. However, wherever the red leaves lead the way, there are some eerie places! If this continues, let alone building a good relationship with humans, it will make people even more frightened... After all, can Onigashima's plan succeed? ?
description.鬼ヶ島プロデュース計画は進み、いよいよ近隣の村人たちを鬼ヶ島に招き入れた一行。鬼: The ghost island planning plan progressed steadily, and the group finally welcomed the villagers from nearby villages into the ghost island. Faced with the unique taste of the ghost tribe, the villagers were a little overwhelmed, but with the clever response of Hongye and Shilaaisi, everyone gradually let down their guard. Can the ghost clan's thoughts be conveyed to the past?
description.鬼族と人間――ふたつの種族が協力したことにより、鬼ヶ島の危機は乗り越えられた。ふ: The ghosts and humans - the two races worked together to finally overcome the crisis on the ghost island. Hongye looked at the scene of the two races toasting and drinking together, showing a satisfied smile. In order to let the protagonist and Silas who said "you're welcome" also feel the hospitality of the ghost clan, Hongye held their hands and brought them to the center of the banquet.
description.鬼族と村人たちの交流は順調に進んでいたが、突如として鬼ヶ島に異変が起こる。クリス: The communication between the ghost clan and the villagers went smoothly, but something suddenly happened on the ghost island. The seal of the crystal was unlocked, and the overflowing power began to summon monsters! Amid the chaos, the villagers began to cast doubt on the ghost clan. In order to protect the villagers from the incoming monster attacks, the protagonist...! ?
description.研究所に呼び出されたフィオナとクリスティはアーデルハイトの開発した新たな訓練用の: Fiona and Christie were called to the institute and asked to provide data for a new training device developed by Adelheid. Christie decided whether to participate through divination and chose to provide assistance, so he and Fiona, who had been enthusiastic from the beginning, challenged the training device "Mirror Corridor".

description.アーデルハイトの準備した兵器を使いこなし、主人公たちは氷河の厄災の殲滅に成功した: With the weapons prepared by Adelheide, the protagonists successfully annihilated the Glacier Disaster. However, the forward base and its surrounding areas also suffered huge losses, and they had to be busy dealing with and repairing the aftermath.
description.エルドラーナ外交官・アウラからの正式な依頼。それは、闇市に出回る『催眠石』の流通: An official comquest from Eldorana diplomat Aura: Completely cut off the circulation channels of the "Hypnotic Stone" circulating in the black market. In other words, we need to find the criminal who channeled the Hypnotic Stone into the black market and neutralize its source of supply, the mineral vein. To this end, a special search force was formed, and the protagonists headed for the large cave.
description.クルルの先導で洞窟を抜けた先に辿り着いたのは、枯れた花々が拡がり、墓標のようなモ: After walking through the cave under the leadership of Kururu, we arrived at a lonely place - withered flowers blooming everywhere and monuments like tombstones standing there. There the protagonists meet again the man wearing the deep hood they met in the Black Tower. The guess that the protagonist had been holding before coincided with the data analyzed by Gorenu's sensor.
description.クルルの動物的感性を頼りに雪の危険地帯をくぐり抜けた一行。そこに、空を飛んでルク: The group relied on Kururu's animal intuition to cross the dangerous snowy terrain. At this time, Sylvia, a girl flying in the sky who claimed to be from Luxnova, landed gracefully. Immediately afterwards, Sienna, the leader of Luxnova, also appeared. They began to tell the secrets of the members of the organization named Luxnova.
description.クルルの嗅覚を頼りに、盗賊団の痕跡を追う一行。そして辿り着いたのは巨大な催眠石と: The group relied on Kururu's sense of smell to track the traces of the thieves. What finally arrived was a vein thought to be a huge sleeping stone, and the thieves who showed fearless smiles in front of it. The magic power felt from the veins was far more powerful than that felt from the upper levels, and the thieves who raised their pickaxes all fainted.
description.シエナの友達だという少女は、主人公たちに救出されシエナの顔を見た途端、意識を失っ: The girl who claimed to be Siena's friend lost consciousness as soon as she saw Siena's face after being rescued by the protagonists. It seemed that the tension was broken, and fatigue suddenly attacked her. In a room at the forward base, Himawari takes care of her, and Siena never leaves. The protagonists come to her like this.
description.シエナは、元の世界に居た頃の過去を思い出す。防災備蓄倉庫でヒマリと一緒に猫を育て: Siena recalls her past in the original world. At that time, she and Himawari raised cats together in the disaster prevention reserve warehouse. Whenever Siena was about to burst out of stress due to the busyness of the student union, Himawari would always comfort her. Also, when their cat was almost attacked by a big wild cat, Himawari stood up bravely. Yes, Himawari is actually a strong girl.
description.シエナ達からこの階層の地図を受け取った一行は、雪道を順調に進んでいく。そこにモフ: After getting the map of this level from Siena and the others, the group moved forward smoothly on the snowy road. At this time, a furry monster "Cotton Rabbit" appeared. The protagonist says this is a valuable source of protein and orders its capture. However, because Sophia hesitated, she allowed the monster to escape. Later, the group found some traces in the shadow of the rock.
description.ヒマリの案内の元、飢餓の厄災の影響があると思われる階層を進んでいく一行。ヒマリの: Under the leadership of Sunflower, the group moved forward to the level suspected of being affected by the hunger disaster. Originally relying on Himawari's memory to take a safe route, he ended up fighting a monster. At this time, Himawari truly realized that she had become the only one holding back the team.
description.ヒマリは、観測気球が送ってきた写真の階層まで行ったことがあった。その時の記憶を辿: Sunflower has been to the level on the photo sent by the observation balloon. She traced her memories of that time and told about the situation at that level. Each time this information is obtained, the protagonist will gradually arrive at a certainty. All the phenomena that occurred at that level were exactly the same as the first disaster that once brought the Torreslia region to the brink of destruction - the "Hungry Catastrophe".
description.ベリサが倒れたのは魔力の使い過ぎによるものだった。安全な岩場に避難し応急処置を済: Belisa fell because of excessive use of magic. The group of people took refuge in a safe rock field, and after completing emergency measures, they decided to take a short rest on the spot. Sophia asks the protagonist how to deal with disaster if it happens again. The protagonist says that the "hungry disaster" that he thought he had defeated is actually still alive. Then he started talking about the possibilities of fighting disasters.
description.モンスターを撃退した主人公たちは、珍しい鉱石を発見する。それを見るやテンションが: After repelling the monster, the protagonist and his party discovered a piece of rare ore. When Marina saw it, her emotions suddenly exploded. She said that this kind of ore is called "Abyss Gem" and it is something that can be traded at a high price. With her businessman soul ignited, Marina started digging happily and didn't stop until her backpack was filled to the brim.
description.ルクスノヴァと協力関係を結ぶことに成功し、無謀と思えた大穴探索に一筋の光が射した: After successfully establishing a cooperative relationship with Luxnova, the seemingly reckless exploration of large caves ushered in a glimmer of hope. The protagonist and his party set out to explore in high spirits, but as they continued to go deeper into the lower levels, the sandstorms containing magic became stronger and more violent...
description.主人公の指示によってソフィア、ベリサ、マリナは迅速に動き、前線基地内の住民は安全: Following the instructions of the protagonist, Sophia, Belisa, and Marina acted quickly, and the residents of the frontline base were safely evacuated to safe buildings. Although the blizzard has stopped, the forward bases are frozen. Since food was also a concern, it was decided to send a rescue request to the three major countries. In order to find out the cause of the abnormal weather, the protagonist goes to Adelheide's research institute.
description.人型厄災は、光の翼を持つ、美しい天使の姿をした厄災を召喚する。人型厄災は言う、こ: The humanoid disaster summoned a disaster with wings of light that resembled a beautiful angel. The humanoid disaster said that this supreme masterpiece will feed on human "sighs". The first bait site it selected was the protagonist's "habitation" - the frontline base.
description.仲間たちが倒れ、飢餓の厄災が迫る。そんな絶体絶命のピンチの中、主人公が採った作戦: The companions fell, and the disaster of hunger approached step by step. In this desperate situation, the protagonist's strategy is to use Luxnova's flying unit to move at high speed, while using explosives and loudspeakers to attract disaster - an extremely dangerous combat plan.
description.催眠石による幻覚から目覚めた一行はモンスターを撃退。どうやら催眠石で幻覚を見せて: The group of people woke up from the hallucination caused by the hypnotic stone and fought off the monster. It seems that this kind of monster has the habit of using hypnotic stones to cause hallucinations in people and then capture them. At this time, the lower level sent out a luminous signal again. Adelheid collected the data and analyzed the flashing patterns. Through analysis, the content of the messages passed between thieves was clarified.
description.催眠石の前で頭を抱えていた盗賊たちが、急に立ち上がり、ぶつぶつと脳内で見える光景: The thieves who had been holding their heads in front of the Hypnotic Stone suddenly stood up and began to mutter to themselves what they saw in their minds. Thinking of the happy illusion they had seen before due to the influence of the Hypnotic Stone, the group smiled bitterly. At this time, they suddenly realized that they had been surrounded by a large group of thieves. Soon, the protagonists noticed the unique properties of this layer...
description.再び謎の不気味な視線を感じる主人公。その視線はシエナも同じように感じていた。その: The protagonist once again felt mysterious and strange sight. Sienna felt the same. Afterwards, the conversation turned to the gang of thieves who had taken up residence in the large cave. Marina argued that they must be eradicated. At this moment, Kururu discovered a piece of ore that emitted a strange light. Marina started digging with bright eyes, but fainted just looking at the stone.
description.司令室にて、『滅んだ街』の報告書を眺めながら深刻な表情を浮かべる主人公。様々な謎: In the command room, the protagonist looked at the report of "Destroyed Town" with a serious expression. Although that level left many mysteries, the most concerning one was the existence of the living thief leader. Although the body is that of a bandit leader, the aura and gaze it exudes make people feel different from humans. The protagonist recalled that it overlapped with something he had felt in the past...
description.地下鉄の入り口を守るように配備された警備ロボットたちを目撃し、一行は強行突破を試: After witnessing the security robots deployed at the subway entrance, the group tried to break through. Finally, he dived underground and lowered the waterproof gate to successfully prevent the robot from invading. There is a subway platform marked "Oseimon". Himawari and the others encountered a mysterious magic stone there.
description.声の主である少女の捜索の為、シエナ、そしてアーデルハイトも同行して大穴探索に向か: In order to find the girl who made the noise, Siena and Adelheide also went to the large cave to explore. There is a volcano-like level with hot atmosphere and flowing lava rivers. The protagonists are advancing in a dangerous level. The rock wall will crack at the slightest sound, and lava will erupt from it. At this time, they discovered that someone on the lower level was sending a luminous signal.
description.大穴から聞こえてくる、謎の声と光。アーデルハイトの科学力をもってしても、その発信: Mysterious sounds and lights coming from the great cave. Even with Adelheid's scientific power, it was impossible to determine the source of the message. Siena seemed to know something about the owner of this voice. As soon as she heard the sound, her expression suddenly changed, and she immediately expressed her desire to explore the large cave.
description.大穴の本格的な調査に乗り出した一行。その目的は、下層で目撃されたという『砂嵐』の: The group embarked on a formal investigation of the large cave. The purpose is to find out the cause of the "sandstorm" witnessed from below. Amid the danger of encountering monsters, the friends still had a relaxed mood like a picnic, and the protagonist also gave instructions to move forward without forming a queue. This made Sophia, a top student at the Knight School, even more anxious -
description.大穴の深層に転移してきた街並みは、まるで廃墟のようだった。巨大な建物は崩壊し、無: When we moved deep into the large cave, the street view in front of us looked like ruins. Huge buildings collapsed and many unmanned cars were abandoned. The group carefully searched for survivors. The sunflower stood motionless in front of the building that had turned into rubble. That's where the apartment she lived in in her original world was located -
description.天才兼変態科学者を自称するアーデルハイトと、ルクスノヴァのリーダーを務めるシエナ: Adelheide, a self-proclaimed genius and perverted scientist, and Siena, the leader of Luxnova. The protagonists return to the forward base with these two men. In front of them stood a huge building built with Adelheid's transcendent technological power.
description.巨大な機械魔獣との激闘を制したかに見えたその時、機械魔獣は急に自爆モードを発動さ: Just when they were about to defeat the huge mechanical monster, the mechanical monster suddenly activated its self-destruct mode. The group recovered Gorenu's remains and took the elevator. After finally reaching the ground, a big explosion occurred overhead, and the observation room of the black tower was blown away. With their backs facing the collapsed iron tombstone, the group of people evacuated there at full speed——
description.廃墟と化した街の中に、突如として現れた巨大な漆黒の塔。色は違うものの、その塔の形: On a ruined street, a huge dark tower suddenly appeared. Although the color is different, the shape of the tower is exactly the same as the giant tower symbolizing the city in Sunflower's original world. In order to find the answer to the fate of the people in this world, the protagonist, Himawari and others headed towards the ominous dark tower.
description.御成門駅で手に入れた路線図。それは、魔石の鉱脈を見つける際に使われたというマジッ: This is the route map obtained at Oneimon Station. It is a magic tool that was said to have been used to find veins of magic stone. Holding this "Demon Vein Signpost" that can change the map according to where it goes, the protagonist and his party headed towards the location of the last magic stone. And the last message left there was shocking in its content, revealing everything that had happened in the world.
description.東の空が白み始める。一晩に渡る飢餓の厄災との激闘は、ようやく幕を閉じる。その戦い: The eastern sky turned fish belly white. The fierce battle with the "Hunger Disaster" that lasted all night finally came to an end. This battle is also the end of a long battle for frontline base Alicia. At the celebration banquet held at the frontline base, Siena and Sunflower quietly left the table and talked alone.
description.欲望の世界に囚われてしまった仲間たち。主人公は何とかして抗おうとするも、同じく欲: Friends trapped in a world of desire. The protagonist tries to resist, but is also involved in the world of desire. What awaits him there is a peaceful and peaceful world without "disasters". In this ideal world, the protagonist senses a sense of inconsistency. Yes, those important things are being erased extremely skillfully...
description.氷河の厄災は雄たけびを上げると、そのまま地中へと沈んでいってしまった。地面の下の: Glacier Calamity let out a roar and then sank into the ground. Kururu noticed that there was huge magic power moving under the ground. The protagonist has already understood the behavior of disasters - disasters will move towards more populated areas. The glacier disaster has only one target, and that is the frontline base that has evacuated surrounding residents.
description.洞窟に残されたヒマリの痕跡から推理を働かせる主人公たち。ヒマリは睡眠薬を飲まされ: The protagonist and his party make inferences based on the traces of sunflowers left in the cave. Sunflower was most likely given sleeping pills and then taken away by the man who was traveling with him. But there is still something puzzling about it. How could such a thoughtful man leave with such obvious physical evidence? Siena knew that this was most likely a trap, but she still chased Sunflower.
description.洞窟に避難し、特濃ポーションで回復を試みる一行。しかし、目覚めた飢餓の厄災の衰弱: A group of people hid in the cave and tried to use a strong potion to restore their condition. However, the debilitating ability possessed by the "Hungry Calamity" after awakening has become so difficult that even special potions have no time to restore it. Feeling that his life was in danger, the protagonist decided to use the flying unit owned by Luxnova, turn the output to the maximum, and attempt a high-speed emergency retreat.
description.激闘の末、ついに天使の厄災を倒すことに成功した一行。しかし、主人公は気が付いてい: After a fierce battle, the group finally succeeded in defeating the angel Calamity. However, the protagonist noticed that as Angel Calamity turned into light particles and dissipated, a figure was quietly leaving. When the temporary peace was restored and the usual celebration banquet was held again, a new darkness began to emerge -
description.盗賊たちが持っていたキーホルダー。それは、シエナが元の世界でヒマリにプレゼントし: That's the keychain the thieves were holding. It was the gift Xiena gave to Sunflower in the original world. Facing the depressed Siena, the protagonist told her that Sunflower was still alive and stated the basis. Siena, who had regained her strength, moved forward with everyone, and ahead, a dangerous narrow path over the lava river was waiting for them——
description.盗賊のお頭は生きていた。しかし、その肉体を奪おうと謎の影が彼に近づく。一方、前線: The bandit leader is still alive. However, in order to seize his body, a mysterious black shadow is approaching him. At the same time, at the frontline base, Sunflower, who had been restored to health after careful care, was working hard to help the command room. Because she wants to repay those members of the frontline base who saved her and treated her well. At this time, Adelheide sent an investigation report about the lower area.
description.相変わらず、小まめな休憩を挟みながら探索を進める一行。しかし、未だに飢餓の厄災は: The group continued to explore while taking a break from time to time. However, the scourge of hunger has yet to be discovered. While resting in the cave, the protagonist recounted the investigation records of the hunger disaster. It mentioned the emergence of a large cave and the fact that a small country surrounding the large cave disappeared from the map due to a starvation disaster——
description.知り尽くした階層での逃走劇。そしておびき寄せた場所で仕向けたドラゴン。すべては盗: An escape drama played out among a familiar class. and dragons that are lured to a predetermined location and dealt with. All this seems to be under the control of the leader of the bandit group. However, Siena defeated them all one after another. After defeating the dragon, everyone cheered. But in this battle, Siena spent all her energy. In front of the protagonist and others who are unable to fight due to their maximum combat strength, the leader of the bandit group blocks their way——
description.砂嵐の厄災を撃破した瞬間、前線基地に大歓声が響き渡った。盛大な祝勝パーティーが開: The moment the sandstorm disaster was defeated, loud cheers erupted from the frontline base. At the grand celebration party, Deputy Commander Alicia talks to the protagonist. "Do you regret taking over as forward base commander," she asked.
description.砂嵐の厄災を撃破してから約１０日後。前線基地は異常気象に見舞われていた。連日に渡: About ten days after defeating the sandstorm disaster. The frontline base encountered abnormal weather. Days of heavy snow and blizzards have left forward bases freezing. The protagonist and others were suddenly hit by a violent blizzard while shoveling snow at the command headquarters. The protagonist considers the safety of the residents and decides to urge everyone to evacuate.
description.突如現れた謎の少女は、犬人族のクルルだった。無邪気にホットチョコレートを平らげる: The mysterious girl who suddenly appears turns out to be Kururu from the dog-human tribe. Watching Kururu innocently sipping hot chocolate, the protagonist noticed the keen five senses of the dog people. If you let Kururu lead the way on the snow path, you can avoid the threat of snow cornices. Kururu said he was traveling to find his parents. She joins the group, and the group decides to take the snowy route.
description.突然の地震によって高層ビルが崩壊を始めた。降り注ぐ瓦礫から逃れるために広場に出た: A sudden earthquake caused high-rise buildings to begin to collapse. In order to avoid the falling rubble, the protagonists fled to the square, but were discovered by the security robot. At this time, the pair of Luo Ji and Grenu appeared again. Grenu noticed that the guard robots looked similar to herself, so she tried to fool them into thinking she was a "friend", but...
description.突然の地震に驚く一行。その揺れはしばらくすると落ち着くが、主人公は先遣隊の報告書: The group was startled by the sudden earthquake. The shock subsided soon after, but the protagonist remembered the advance team's report. Records show that earthquakes were followed by subsidence and sandstorms. The protagonist proposes to be more cautious in the next exploration, but notices that Belisa has disappeared at some point.
description.縦横無尽に宙を舞い、光の剣を振り回し、瞬く間に巨大なモンスターを吹き飛ばした２つ: Two shadows flew vertically and horizontally in the air, waving their lightsabers and instantly blasting the huge monster away. The girls who appear before the protagonists call themselves Luxnova.
description.背後から一定の距離を保ったまま付いてくる謎の気配。その足音から、人間のものだと察: The mysterious aura that always remains at a certain distance behind you. Judging from the footsteps, the protagonists realized that they were human beings. While pretending not to notice that she was being followed, Sophia tried to conduct reconnaissance on her own. Sophia lurks in the shadow of the rock, trying to expose the true identity of the stalker, but...
description.背後で渦巻く無数の人魂と、その絶望の声を振り切って駆け出した一行は、ようやく見つ: Throwing away the countless human souls hovering behind them and their desperate cries, the group of people ran wildly and finally escaped into the discovered cave. Recalling the voice of the blue-black soul, Sunflower said with tears in her eyes: "That voice... is the same as the voice Sunflower heard from the stone on the subway platform..."
description.街に催眠石が蔓延し、人々を幻覚の世界に閉じ込めてしまっている。一刻を争う事態を解: Hypnotic stones spread across the streets, trapping people in a world of hallucinations. In order to race against time to resolve the situation, the protagonists decided to arrest the thieves who caused the riot. Professor Luo Ji and Grenu, who were once enemies, have also joined the team, and a new adventure is about to begin.
description.調査に乗り出した階層は、氷と雪の世界。アーデルハイトから貰った装備を身に着け慎重: The class under investigation is the Ice World. Despite marching cautiously while wearing the equipment given by Adelheide, Sophia stepped on a snow cornice and almost slipped off the cliff. The group avoids dangerous routes and looks for other paths. However, safe routes are always difficult to find. In front of the exhausted people, monsters appeared——
description.警備ロボットの追跡を逃れた一行は、地下鉄の入り口へと向かう。しかし、入り口は崩落: A group of people escaped from the tracking of the guard robot and rushed towards the subway entrance. However, the entrance has collapsed and cannot be used. Although they were attacked by the robot, everyone successfully repelled it. The protagonist also dismantled the robot and collected its parts. The manufacturer's name printed on it is subtly different from the company name that Sunflower is known for.
description.遺体となった騎士が遺してくれたメモ書きによって、調査隊が壊滅した原因を突き止めた: According to the notes left by the knight's body, the group found out the reason why the investigation team was wiped out and decided to retreat back to the frontline base. However, following the shortcut guided by the notes, there was a stronghold of a band of thieves waiting for them ahead——
description.避難場所を目指して迂回ルートを進む一行。しかし、その道も瓦礫によって塞がれてしま: The group took a detour to get to the shelter. But that road, too, was blocked by rubble. Himawari suggested that if you could find the subway entrance, you might be able to bypass it underground. At this moment, two familiar figures appeared in the rubble, rummaging for something.
description.雪の中からマリナを救出した一同は、近くの洞窟を発見し、そこで体の冷え切ったマリナ: After everyone rescued Marina from the snow, they discovered a nearby cave and treated her frozen body on the spot. In order to restore the body temperature of Marina who was suffering from hypothermia, Kururu and the others took off their clothes and used their bodies to warm her. At this moment, a huge threat is approaching the protagonists——
description.雪崩に呑み込まれたマリナを必死になって捜索する一行。ソフィアが中心になって冷静に: A group of people desperately search for Marina who was swallowed by an avalanche. Sofia calmly analyzed the situation and tried to find Marina's belongings, but found nothing. Considering that Marina might have been washed farther away together with her backpack, everyone asked Kururu to use their sense of smell to find the smell of the potion that Marina was carrying.
description.飢餓の厄災の捜索の為、闇の階層を進む一行。この階層は体力の消耗が激しく、少し動い: In order to search for the disaster of famine, a group of people went deep into the darkness. This layer consumes physical energy intensely, and even the slightest movement can cause extreme thirst and hunger. The protagonists decided to rest frequently and use potions and food to replenish their physical strength before moving forward. During the break, everyone talked about the girl with the iron golem mentioned in the exploration team’s report——
description.駅の壁に貼られた路線図。しかし、その駅名は、ヒマリの住んでいた街とは全く違うもの: Route maps are posted on the walls of the station. However, those station names are completely different from the city where Himawari lives. After feeling the faint magic in the map, the group took down the road map and walked along the railroad tracks to the next stop. That's where the elementary school gymnasium in the area where Himawari originally lived was designated as a refuge.
description.アーデルハイトに作ってもらったドローンを飛ばし、未知の階層を調査する主人公たち。: The protagonist and his party fly a drone made by Adelheide to investigate an unknown class. At this moment, a demon girl named Liela came to the research institute and informed everyone that a certain magic stone had been taken away from the demon settlement. Liela claimed that those who took away the magic stone were a group of people dressed in white——
description.トラップの回廊、上空からのモンスターを切り抜けた一行は、暗い一本道の廊下へと進む: After breaking through the trap corridor and the monster from the sky, the group walked into a dark and straight corridor. At this time, Elsa sang loudly and walked from the front. Aisha insisted that she had been running away in a straight line after being separated from everyone, but...
description.ルインフォス教団の教祖と司祭が前線基地へと尋ねてくる。教祖は、教団の一部の者たち: The patriarch and priest of the Ruinfus Order came to the frontline base. The cult leader informed everyone that some members of the cult stole magic stones from a certain settlement and headed to the large cave. But the Patriarch said that such behavior was against the teachings of the Order. At this moment, Alicia said that a group of people dressed in white were captured in the image returned by the drone.
description.人型厄災と融合した天使の厄災を撃破してから、前線基地には束の間の平穏が訪れていた: After defeating the Angelic Calamity that merged with the humanoid Calamity, the frontline base experienced a brief period of peace. Just then, Felicione, the leader of the Perdion Empire, sent a letter. It is said that a suspicious religious group has been secretly operating recently, and she hopes that the frontline base will investigate that group. The protagonist plans to go on a reconnaissance trip alone, but——
description.処刑場の奥の広間に出た一行は、白装束の数十人の信者たちが、まるで何かに憑りつかれ: The group came to the hall deep inside the execution ground and saw dozens of believers in white lining up in a long queue, walking towards the altar as if they were possessed by something. They sprinkled snow-white ashes onto the altar from the pots they held in their arms. After seeing this, everyone realized that the white ashes were the remains of the demons who were burned to death in this city.
description.広場が大騒ぎになる中、ゴレイヌはロジーを肩に乗せて逃走する。しかし、迫りくる信者: The square fell into a commotion, and Gorenou put Roji on his shoulders and began to escape. However, while knocking away the approaching believers, it rushed towards the stone pillar where the protagonist and his party were hiding. The protagonist and others were surrounded by believers in an instant. At this moment, a violent explosion occurred behind them——
description.押し寄せてきた亡霊たちを退けた主人公たちは、部屋の壁一面に飾られている連作画の存: After the protagonist and his party repelled the swarming undead, they discovered that the entire wall of the room was covered with a series of paintings. Those paintings told the blood-stained history between humans and demons in this city. In the process of investigating these tragic paintings, everyone witnessed with their own eyes the cruel atrocities that humans had committed against the demons -
description.遠くから聞こえてきた物騒な声を頼りに駆け寄った主人公たち。そこにいたのは、モンス: The protagonist and his party rushed to follow the dangerous shouts coming from the distance, and found that there was a second demon girl there who was surrounded by monsters. After a fierce battle with the monster, the protagonist asked her for help, but...
description.錆びついた死の道具が積み上がる武器庫の奥へ進んだ一行は、豪奢な銀の装飾が施された: The group of people went deep into the weapons warehouse filled with rusted murder instruments and came to a huge door decorated with luxurious silver ornaments. Looking at the ominous decorations with the theme of demons, the protagonist and others started various reasonings. While they were watching out for traps, they were thinking about how to open the door without a keyhole. However, Elsa ignored the protagonist's stop and stretched her hand towards the door...
description.魔族の亡霊たちの魂が、空の彼方へ昇っていく――。リエラとアイシャは別世界の同胞た: The souls of the undead demons ascend to the distant sky——. Liela and Elsa prayed for their compatriots in the other world, and told the protagonist how they would survive to comfort their unfinished regrets. Then the celebration banquet officially began. While everyone was resolute in their determination for the next exploration, only one girl showed a worried expression.

description.マーケットでベリサに絡まれ困惑する主人公の前に、再び謎の美女ルディアが現れる。彼: In front of the protagonist who is entangled and confused by Belisa in the market, the mysterious beauty Ludia appears again. She tells the protagonist that as the frontline base of the war, there is a lack of entertainment that nourishes people's hearts, and proposes to invest in converting a deserted hotel into an "ideal store." However, although Ludia's bar has been built, her real purpose of opening the shop is something else -
description.前線基地に新しくできた謎の酒場。その噂を聞きつけたベリサは、店主のルディアに「強: A mysterious new tavern has opened in the frontline base. After Belissa heard the rumors, she was cleverly persuaded by the shop owner Ludia - saying "there is a way to become stronger", and then started to work with some doubts. At first, her job was just chores like washing dishes and cleaning, but Belisa changed the atmosphere of the store with her natural cheerfulness, and unknowingly became the "signature girl" of the pub, winning the favor of the guests.

description.アリシアと共に前線基地にやって来た主人公。前線基地司令官に就任早々、司令本部で各: The protagonist and Alicia arrived at the forward base together. As soon as he took office as the commander of the frontline base, he met Sophia, Marina and Belisa who had gathered from various countries at the headquarters. Without gaining the full trust of those around him, the protagonist begins to look through the lists of volunteers from various countries.
description.アリシアは、辺境の地の砦へとやってくる。 そこに、人類存亡の鍵を握る人物――かつ: Alicia arrived at the fortress of the frontier fortress. It is said that there is a person who holds the key to the survival of mankind - a descendant of the hero who once saved the world, who is stationed here. Alicia asked this man, who was rumored to be smart but awkward, to serve as the commander of the forward base.
description.ペルディオン皇国の”円卓の間”に、三大国の外交担当である３人が集結している。ミレ: In the Perdion Empire's "Between the Round Table", the diplomatic leaders of the three major countries gathered together. Lezelia, the representative of Miresgard, Felicione, the representative of Perdion, and Ola, the representative of Eldorana, are talking about the forward base commander who was entrusted to Alicia to appoint a few days ago.
description.主人公が前線基地の司令官に就任してしばらく経った頃。ソフィア、ベリサ、マリナら探: Some time has passed since the protagonist assumed command of the forward base. He also established a trusting relationship with explorers such as Sophia, Belisa, and Marina, and the investigation of all levels of the large cave went smoothly. However, many incomprehensible mysteries remain within the various levels of the Great Cave. At this moment, a group of monsters appeared in front of a group of people——
description.大穴を探索中の部隊の前に、瘴気が立ち込める。それは数か月前、突如大穴より出現し、: Miasma spread in front of the troops exploring the large cave. This is the same phenomenon as when a huge monster suddenly appeared from a large cave a few months ago and turned the surrounding villages into scorched earth overnight. Then, a giant monster called the ‘Hungry Calamity’ appeared in front of the exploration team——
description.飢餓の厄災撃退後、主人公は独り丘の上で苦悩していた。そこに現れたのは、ルディアと: After repelling the scourge of famine, the protagonist is alone in the hills suffering. At this time, a mysterious beauty named Ludia appeared. She said that she was guided by the protagonist's "Hero's Blood" and called the protagonist's companions "locked treasure chests called possibilities". Then she expressed her intention to grant the "Key to All Things" to open the lock, then smiled slyly and kissed the protagonist's lips gently -

Can be reached from here

In the big cave, not only monsters,
Even the environment itself

As the exploration of the large cave advances,

to this forward base

Do you have any products you like?

text.私のことも気になるようですね。\nふふっ、それはまた後程……:

description.煉獄の厄災により喚び出される火球。\n何をするでもなく佇み、ただ燃えているが\n:

Just stay quietly and keep burning,
In the end, he returned to the disaster as if he was attracted.

If there is an investigator in the burning state, 【Hellfire Lv】 will increase, but this can be inhibited by absorbing mana, which is

An android that plays tricks on adventurers who dream of getting rich overnight.
I thought it was luck incarnate...
His true identity is a trickster who rubs his feet with oil.

flavor_text.万物を照らす光の元素が意志を持ち具現化した姿。\n厄災による影響か非常に好戦的で:
The element of light that illuminates all things is manifested after gaining will.
Perhaps affected by the disaster, he is extremely warlike.
It will target nearby humans and attempt to pierce them with flashes of light.
flavor_text.万物を飲み込む闇の元素が意志を持ち具現化した姿。\n厄災による影響か非常に好戦的:
The form of the dark element that swallows all things and manifests itself after gaining will.
Perhaps affected by the disaster, he is extremely warlike.
It will target nearby humans in an attempt to take away all the light.
flavor_text.偽りの希望を与え滅びへと向かわせる天使の厄災。\n厄災が眷属の数に応じて【信仰L:
A calamity of angels who give false hope and lead to destruction. 
 Calamity changes 【 Faith Lv】 according to the number of followers, and 
 changes the effects of various skills accordingly.
flavor_text.元は氷河の厄災だった存在が変異した、特級の厄災。\n万物の熱量を奪う絶対零度の絶:
A special disaster that was mutated from the original glacier disaster.
The absolute zero degree of despair that robs all things of heat,
It is turning the entire world into a still ice statue.
flavor_text.光の精霊と契約したエルフの弓使い。\nその矢は、敵を光で包み込む。\n森の守護者:
An elven archer who has made a pact with the light elves.
Its arrows surround the enemy with light.
As the guardian of the forest, we will never forgive intruders.
flavor_text.光の翼を持つ天使の姿をした厄災。\n人々に偽りの希望を与え、滅びへと向かわせる。:
Calamity possesses wings of light and the appearance of an angel.
Giving people false hope leads them to destruction.
