Its fangs are sharp, making it impossible for prey to escape.
The light spewed from its mouth can blind everything.
desciption.呪われた花弁を持つ食人植物。\nその牙は鋭く獲物を逃さない。\n口から吐き出す瘴:
A man-eating plant with cursed petals.
Its fangs are sharp, making it impossible for prey to escape.
The miasma spewing from its mouth corrupts everything.
desciption.花弁が咲く前の食人植物。\nその牙は鋭く獲物を逃さない。\n口から吐き出す胞子は:
A man-eating plant with unopened petals.
Its fangs are sharp, making it impossible for prey to escape.
The spores ejected from its mouth confuse its prey.
desciption.灼熱の斧を振るう、牛頭人身のモンスター。\nその獰猛な突進は炎の嵐を巻き起こし、:
A tauren monster wielding a searing axe.
Its ferocious charge set off a storm of fire,
Burn the battlefield to the ground.
desciption.巨大な錨を振り回す、牛頭人身のモンスター。\nその荒波のような攻撃はすべてを飲み:
A minotaur monster wielding a giant anchor.
Its attack like a raging wave devoured everything,
Freeze the battlefield into ice.
desciption.重いこん棒を振り下ろす、牛頭人身のモンスター。\nその一撃は大地を揺るがし、\n:
The tauren monster smashed down the heavy hammer.
Its blow shook the earth,
Crush everything.
desciption.聖なる剣を掲げる、牛頭人身のモンスター。\nその光に満ちた刃は邪悪を断ち切り、\:
A minotaur monster holding a holy sword high.
Its radiant blade cuts off evil,
Purify everything.
desciption.巨大ハンマーを叩きつける牛頭人身のモンスター。\nその一撃は影をも打ち砕き、\n:
The minotaur monster dropped the giant hammer.
One of its blows can shatter shadows,
Dye everything with darkness.
desciption.強靭な鉄槌を振るう、牛頭人身のモンスター。\nその豪腕は、いかなる盾も打ち砕き、:
A minotaur monster wielding a powerful hammer.
His mighty arms can shatter any shield,
Crush your enemies without mercy.
desciption.炎の鱗を持つ大トカゲ。\n口から灼熱の溶岩を吐き、戦場を灰に変える。\n近づく者:
A giant lizard with flaming scales.
Spewing hot lava from its mouth, it turns the battlefield into ashes.
The ruler of the flames who doesn't allow anyone to get close.
desciption.氷の鱗を持つ大トカゲ。\n口から極寒の氷結液を吐き相手を凍てつかせる。\n冷気を:
A giant lizard with ice scales.
Spits extremely cold liquid from its mouth to freeze the opponent.
The scales wrapped in the cold air carved traces of frost with just a single touch.
desciption.岩の鱗を持つ大トカゲ。\n口から泥を吐き、敵を土の下に埋める。\nその姿は、大地:
A giant lizard with rock scales.
It spits mud from its mouth and buries the enemy in the ground.
His posture is like the fury of the earth manifested.
desciption.輝く鱗を持つ大トカゲ。\n眩い光を口から放ち、視界を奪い焼き尽くす。\n聖なる輝:
A giant lizard with shining scales.
Releases a blinding light from its mouth, taking away vision and burning it.
Although he is clothed with divine glory, his nature is that of a ruthless predator.
desciption.闇の鱗を持つ大トカゲ。\n口から闇を吐き、相手を永遠の暗闇に閉じ込める。\n光を:
A monitor lizard with dark scales.
Spews darkness from its mouth, sealing the opponent in eternal darkness.
The light-absorbing scales wriggle strangely, luring you into the abyss of despair.
desciption.鉄の鱗を持つ大トカゲ。\n口から透明な液体を放ち、毒牙にかける。\n無機質な鱗の:
A giant lizard with iron scales.
It sprays clear liquid from its mouth and attacks with its fangs.
Hidden beneath the cold, lifeless scales is a ruthless killing instinct.
desciption.呪われし力を持つ鋼鉄の守護者。\nその大剣は、侵入者を断ち切り、\nその鎧は、決:
The Iron Guardian with cursed power.
His great sword cuts off the intruder,
Its armor will never break.
desciption.神秘な力を持つ鋼鉄の守護者。\nその大剣は、侵入者を断ち切り、\nその鎧は、決し:
The Iron Guardian with mysterious powers.
His great sword cuts off the intruder,
Its armor will never break.
desciption.炎の鱗を持つ翼竜。\n口から灼熱のブレスを吐き、大地を焦がす。\nその咆哮は空を:
A flying dragon with flaming scale armor.
Fiery breath spewed from its mouth, scorching the earth.
Its roar turns the sky red. Keeper of the Flame.
desciption.氷の鱗を持つ翼竜。\n口から凍てつくブレスを吐き、万物を氷結させる。\nその翼が:
A flying dragon with ice scales.
Breathing out cold breath from its mouth, it freezes everything.
When its wings flap, a blizzard dances wildly. Guardian of the glacier.
desciption.巨大な合成魔獣。岩山のような固い角を持つ。\n一突きで大地を揺るがし、\n対峙者:
A huge synthetic monster. It has horns as hard as rocks.
A thrust shook the earth,
Push those who confront you into the abyss.
desciption.異世界の技術で造られらた合成魔獣。\nその角の硬度はダイヤモンドに匹敵し、\nあ:
A synthetic monster created with technology from another world.
Its horns are as hard as diamonds,
Can penetrate everything.
desciption.火属性の扱いに長けた盗賊。\nいかなる環境下においても獲物を攻撃する\n厄介な情:
A thief who is proficient in fire attributes.
Persistently attack prey under any circumstances,
Possessing a thorny passion.
desciption.水属性の扱いに長けた盗賊。\nいかなる環境下においても獲物を逃さない\n厄介な冷:
A thief who is proficient in water attributes.
Do not let prey escape under any circumstances,
Possessing a prickly calmness.
desciption.土属性の扱いに長けた盗賊。\nいかなる環境下においても獲物を追い続ける\n厄介な:
A thief who is proficient in earth attributes.
He pursues his prey under any circumstances,
Possessing incredible toughness.
desciption.光属性の扱いに長けた盗賊。\nいかなる環境下においても獲物を諦めない\n厄介なポ:
A thief who is proficient in light attributes.
Not willing to give up prey under any circumstances,
Possessing a thorny optimism.
desciption.闇属性の扱いに長けた盗賊。\nいかなる環境下においても獲物をいたぶる\n厄介な陰:
A thief who is proficient in dark attributes.
Torturing prey under any circumstances,
Possessing a troubling insidiousness.
desciption.武器の扱いに長けた盗賊。\nいかなる環境下においても獲物を無心で追う\n厄介な集:
A thief who is proficient in the use of weapons.
Hunt without distraction under any circumstances,
Possessing a tricky concentration.
desciption.火属性の扱いに非常に長けた盗賊のリーダー。\nあらゆる状況下で常に獲物を攻撃する:
The leader of thieves who is extremely proficient in the fire attribute.
Always attack prey under any circumstances,
Possessing an almost paranoid enthusiasm.
desciption.水属性の扱いに非常に長けた盗賊のリーダー。\nあらゆる状況下で常に獲物を逃がさな:
The leader of thieves who is extremely proficient in water attributes.
Never let prey escape under any circumstances,
Possessing an almost paranoid calmness.
desciption.土属性の扱いに非常に長けた盗賊のリーダー。\nあらゆる状況下で常に獲物を追い続け:
The leader of thieves who is extremely proficient in earth attributes.
Always pursue the prey under any circumstances,
Possessing an almost paranoid tenacity.
desciption.光属性の扱いに非常に長けた盗賊のリーダー。\nあらゆる状況下で常に獲物をあきらめ:
The leader of thieves who is extremely proficient in light attributes.
Never give up on prey under any circumstances,
Possessing an almost paranoid optimism.
desciption.闇属性の扱いに非常に長けた盗賊のリーダー。\nあらゆる状況下で常に獲物をいたぶる:
The leader of thieves who is extremely proficient in dark attributes.
Always tormenting its prey under any circumstances,
Possessing an almost paranoid viciousness.
desciption.武器の扱いに非常に長けた盗賊のリーダー。\nあらゆる状況下で常に獲物を無心で追う:
The leader of thieves who is extremely proficient in the use of weapons.
Always pursue the hunt without distraction, no matter the situation.
Possessing an almost paranoid concentration.
desciption.燃え盛る炎の元素が意志を持ち具現化した姿。\n厄災による影響か非常に好戦的で近く:
The blazing flame element manifests itself after gaining will.
Perhaps affected by the disaster, he is extremely warlike.
Will target nearby humans in an attempt to incinerate them.
desciption.流れ滴る水の元素が意志を持ち具現化した姿。\n厄災による影響か非常に好戦的で近く:
The form of the dripping water element that has gained its will and materialized.
Perhaps affected by the disaster, he is extremely warlike.
Will target nearby humans in an attempt to flush them away.
desciption.壮大なる大地の元素が意志を持ち具現化した姿。\n厄災による影響か非常に好戦的で近:
The elements of the majestic earth are manifested after gaining will.
Perhaps affected by the disaster, he is extremely warlike.
Will target nearby humans in an attempt to crush them.
desciption.万物を照らす光の元素が意志を持ち具現化した姿。\n厄災による影響か非常に好戦的で:
The element of light that illuminates all things is manifested after gaining will.
Perhaps affected by the disaster, he is extremely warlike.
It will target nearby humans and attempt to pierce them with flashes of light.
desciption.万物を飲み込む闇の元素が意志を持ち具現化した姿。\n厄災による影響か非常に好戦的:
The form of the dark element that swallows all things and manifests itself after gaining will.
Perhaps affected by the disaster, he is extremely warlike.
It will target nearby humans in an attempt to take away all the light.
desciption.虚ろなる無の元素が意志を持ち具現化した姿。\n厄災による影響か非常に好戦的で近く:
The void element of the void manifests itself after gaining will.
Perhaps affected by the disaster, he is extremely warlike.
Will target nearby humans and attempt to drag them into the void.
desciption.かつては聖職者だった邪悪な霊。\n実体を持たず有効な攻撃が限られるため、\n不慣:
An evil ghost who was a clergyman in life.
Since there is no entity, the attacks that can work are very limited.
Inexperienced explorers can easily be sent to heaven.
desciption.属性は火と闇。人間と魔族が激しい戦いを\n繰り広げていた別世界において、人間に\:
Fire and dark attributes. From a human and demon clan
A different world where fierce fighting once took place. suffered by humans
The anger and sadness of the destroyed demons,
This disaster was caused after turning into a flaming monster.
It will burn everything around it with karmic fire,
With the everlasting fire of resentment, all things
reduced to ashes.
The cult used stolen magic stones and demon ashes to
Successfully manifested it within the level of the Great Cave.
desciption.死の気配をまとい生者を憎む邪悪な霊。\n実体を持たず有効な攻撃が限られるため\n:
An evil ghost that haunts the aura of death and hates the living.
Since there is no entity, the attacks that can work are very limited.
Inexperienced explorers will also be completely swallowed by darkness in the future.
desciption.水死した恨みを抱え、生者を妬む邪悪な霊。\n実体を持たず有効な攻撃が限られるため:
An evil ghost that hates death and is jealous of the living.
Since there is no entity, the attacks that can work are very limited.
An unwary explorer can easily be dragged into the water by it.
desciption.洞窟内で孤独に果て、仲間を求める邪悪な霊。\n実体を持たず有効な攻撃が限られるた:
An evil ghost who died alone in a cave and longed for companions.
Since there is no entity, the attacks that can work are very limited.
Explorers who feel sympathy for it will meet the same end.
desciption.生者に嫉妬の炎を燃やし執着する邪悪な霊。\n実体を持たず有効な攻撃が限られるため:
An evil ghost that stokes the flames of jealousy and clings to the living.
Since there is no entity, the attacks that can work are very limited.
Explorers who have no means of resistance will be burned to a crisp.
desciption.虚無に取り込まれ良心を喪った邪悪な霊。\n実体を持たず有効な攻撃が限られるため\:
An evil ghost swallowed by nothingness and losing his conscience.
Since there is no entity, the attacks that can work are very limited.
The attacks of the weak explorers will be in vain.
desciption.蜘蛛と人が混ざり合った姿をしたモンスター。\n体内で生成された鋼のごとく強靭な粘:
A monster with a hybrid shape of spider and human.
The sticky threads produced in the body are as tough as steel,
It will entangle the target and deprive it of freedom of movement.
desciption.蜘蛛と人が混ざり合った姿をしたモンスター。\n光の属性をその身に宿しており、放た:
A monster with a hybrid shape of spider and human.
The body contains light attributes, and the sticky threads shot out
It will entangle the target at the speed of light.
desciption.蜘蛛と人が混ざり合った姿をしたモンスター。\n土の属性をその身に宿しており、放た:
A monster with a hybrid shape of spider and human.
The earth element resides in the body, and the sticky threads shot out
It will entangle the target layer by layer like lush grass.
desciption.蜘蛛と人が混ざり合った姿をしたモンスター。\n水の属性をその身に宿しており、放た:
A monster with a hybrid shape of spider and human.
The body contains water properties, and the sticky threads shot out
It will pour towards the target with the momentum of a torrential rain.
desciption.蜘蛛と人が混ざり合った姿をしたモンスター。\n火の属性をその身に宿しており、放た:
A monster with a hybrid shape of spider and human.
The fire attribute resides in the body, and the sticky threads shot out
It will entangle the target like a raging flame.
desciption.蜘蛛と人が混ざり合った姿をしたモンスター。\n闇の属性をその身に宿しており、放た:
A monster with a hybrid shape of spider and human.
The dark attribute resides in the body, and the sticky threads shot out
It will completely cover the target like a shadow.
desciption.古くから船乗りたちに恐れられているモンスター。\n水辺に棲まい美しい歌声で対象を:
A monster that has been feared by sailors since ancient times.
It lives by the water and uses its beautiful songs to confuse and manipulate its targets.
Legend has it that it is a stunning beauty, but that is just an illusion created by the song.

serif.夏だよ、ご主人さまっ！\nクルルと一緒にたっっくさん遊ぼうね♪:
Summer is here, Master!
Let’s have enough fun with Kururu♪
serif.水着メイド・ニナとの夏のバカンス――\n心ゆくまでご堪能ください、御主人様:
Summer vacation with swimsuit maid Nina——
Please enjoy it, Master
serif.オートマタのウェンディと申します\nあの、力仕事は得意です！:
I am Wendy the automaton
Well, I'm good at physical work!
serif.ベリサお姉ちゃんはどこでしょうか？\nあ、わたし妹のヴィーラです。:
Where is Sister Belisa?
Ah, I am her sister Vera.
serif.最高の舞台を見せるわよ\nうちの虜にしてあ・げ・る♡:
I will show you the best stage
Let you be my prisoner♡
serif.さぁ、狩りの時間だ！\nボクの弓からは逃げられないよ♪:
Come on, it's hunting time!
You can't escape my bow♪
serif.伝説の大海賊の末裔、ルシータだ！\nアタシと新たな航海に出発しようぜ！:
I am the descendant of the legendary great pirate, Lucita!
Come on a new voyage with me!
serif.ん？ お父さん……！？\nあ、なんだ、司令官か:
Um? Dad...! ?
Ah, what, it’s the commander.
serif.エルフのシラエスだ。これから君に協力\nしよう。何十年何百年……何千年とね。:
I'm the elf Shielais. Let me help you from now on.
Whether it's decades, centuries... or even thousands of years.
serif.婚姻の儀を終えるまで……\n誰にも、この想いは止められません:
Before completing the wedding ceremony…
No one can stop my feelings.
serif.ウェーイ！ 今日は\nやりらふぃーなノリで決めちゃうよ！:
yeah--! Want it today too
Stunning the audience with the hottest and trendiest style!
serif.フィオナとポパパポパは\nとっても仲が良いんですよぉ:
Fiona and Poppa Poppa
The relationship is very good~
serif.星々が描く運命の交差点……\nさあ、あなたはどの道を選ぶの？:
The intersection of destiny drawn by the stars...
Come on, which path will you choose?
serif.我が名はコトノ。この剣と共に\n身命を捧げ、お仕えいたします:
My name is Kotono. I would like to be with this sword
I dedicate my life and property to serve you.

description.ある天才発明家が発明した光線銃。\nその威力は凄まじいため、現在は使われていない:
A ray gun built by a genius inventor.
Due to its amazing power, it is no longer used.
In addition to emitting powerful light, it also seems to have some special functions.
description.ある異世界の学芸員が愛用している道具セット。\n掃除、予定管理、書類仕事、大穴探:
A tool set commonly used by a certain artist from another world.
From cleaning, scheduling, paperwork to exploring large caves,
They are all reliable and versatile tools to support busy work.
description.きらきらと輝く星をイメージして作られた杖。\n青色のリボンと星の装飾には、”世界:
A staff made with the image of shining stars.
Decorated with blue ribbons and stars, you can feel
A strong desire to "restore peace to the world".
description.この武器スキンは現在入手できません。: This weapon appearance is currently unavailable.
description.シラエスが携える、長き叡智を宿した神秘の杖。\n杖を振れば蝶の魔弾が、雲石の如く:
The mysterious staff carried by Shilaais and filled with time-honored wisdom.
When you wave your wand, magic butterfly bullets will fall from the sky like meteorites.
The wisdom she has accumulated over many years will fill the battlefield with light.
description.主への給仕に使う手を汚さぬ為にニナが装着する籠手。\n舞踏を舞う如き優雅な動きで:
Gauntlets worn by Nina to keep her hands clean while serving her master.
She gallops across the battlefield to defeat her targets with graceful movements like a dance.
The rapid combos leave no trace of dust behind, sweeping away all the dirt on the battlefield.
description.大地の産声を宿した宝剣。刃を振るう度に軽やかな\n旋律が響き、邪な魂を浄化すると:
The sword that holds the first cry of the earth. Every time you swing your sword, a light melody will sound,
It is said to purify evil spirits. It will resonate with the holder's fighting spirit, awaken the power of the earth, and lead the battlefield to victory.
description.星の占い師クリスティが携える、神秘の杖。\n杖を振れば夜空を焦がし、巨大な流星群:
The mysterious staff carried by Christie, the Star Diviner.
When you wave your staff, huge meteors will scorch the night sky and rain down.
The guidance of the stars illuminates the future, turning into a light that burns away despair.
description.朧月夜の如く揺らめく幻影の刃。生者の剣では届かぬ\n霊体さえも斬り裂き、迷える魂:
The phantom blade sways like a hazy moonlit night. A sword that can even cut through the living
The untouchable spirit brings the lost soul to nothingness.
It will resonate with the accompanying spirit body and cut down the incorporeal enemies as well.
description.歯車の中央で輝く魔石は、胎内の魔導炉と共鳴し、\n高速回転する歯車が、強力な魔力:
The magic stone shining in the center of the gear will resonate with the magic furnace in the body.
The high-speed rotating gears inject powerful magic into the blade.
She will eliminate her target completely with one emotionless blow.
description.水の精霊術を操るフィオナが携える、神秘の弓。\n精霊の力を得た矢は激流となり標的:
The mysterious bow carried by Fiona, who controls the water spirit magic.
The arrows that gained the power of the elves turned into torrents and penetrated the target with great force.
Praying with the elves will make the battlefield full of life.
description.激しく燃え盛る業火を放つ一騎当千の威力を秘めた弓。\n彼女が放つ一射は、戦局を独:
A bow that releases the blazing fire of karma and contains the power of a thousand.
The arrow she shot was enough to change the outcome of the battle on her own.
The roaring flaming arrows will turn the enemy in the way to ashes.
description.白く小さな花の装飾が施された探索用ピッケル。\n使用していると周囲を注意深く観察:
Exploration pickaxe decorated with small white flowers.
When using it, you will be tempted to look around carefully.
Its color and shape are reminiscent of some kind of flower.
description.美しい銀の装飾が施された、銃身の軽い猟銃。\n放たれる弾丸は狼の牙の如く、獲物の:
A shotgun decorated with beautiful silver ornaments and with a lightweight barrel.
The bullets fired kill the prey like wolf fangs.
No target can escape the ruthless sniper attack.
description.蒼玉の魔石を冠した氷の杖。溢れ出す制御不能な魔力を\n魔石で安定させ、絶大なる氷:
An ice staff inlaid with beryl magic stone. Magic stones will flow out steadily and continuously.
Losing control of magic and converging it into astonishingly powerful ice magic.
Raging extremely low temperature fluctuations will turn everything into silent frozen soil.
description.蝶の如く舞い、蜂の如く刺す、舞踏家の手甲。\nフラフープの円舞から放たれる鋭い一:
A dancer's gauntlet that dances like a butterfly and stings like a bee.
The sharp blow released from the hula hoop round dance,
It will mercilessly penetrate the enemy's vital points along a freely changing trajectory.
description.迅雷の魔力を秘めた狩猟弓。引き絞るほどに\n雷光を増し、稲妻の如き一矢で全てを貫:
A hunting bow that contains thunder magic. The fuller the bow string is drawn,
The thunder became stronger and stronger, piercing everything with lightning-like arrows.
No prey can escape the light speed bursts.
description.酒樽を模した、エミリー特製の不思議な大樽ハンマー。\n振り下ろせば黄金のエールが:
A magical barrel hammer modeled after a wine barrel and specially made by Emily.
When swung down, golden ale pours out, energizing allies.
It is a magical item that brings the noise of a banquet to the battlefield and makes people energetic.
description.金銀の装飾が美しく輝く、海賊ルシータが誇る愛用銃。\n絶命の瞬間でさえ敵を道連れ:
The gold and silver decoration shines beautifully, and the pirate Lucita is proud of her favorite gun.
The trigger holds the obsession to bury the enemy with him even if he is dying.
The shot will drag the enemy deep into the sea.
description.開発者グラディアが設計したドリル一体型の特殊重槌。\n高速回転する先端部が、硬質:
A special weight integrated into the drill bit designed by developer Gratia.
The high-speed rotating front end can easily crush even hard rock formations.
The blow that knocked down, gouged and penetrated the target could break through even the iron-clad defenses.
description.陰陽師ヒナギが紐解く、陰陽五行・水の理を記した書。\n水系の陰陽術が放つ清流は、:
A book that records the principles of yin-yang, five elements and water, interpreted by Onmyoji Daisy.
The clear flow released by the water-based onmyoji will gently wrap around people,
Restore the clear flow of blood and bring peace to partners in battle.
description.鬼族のクレハが携える、羅刹の魂が宿る重厚な剣と盾。\n常人には重すぎるが、鬼族の:
A thick sword and shield carried by Momiji of the Oni tribe, housing the soul of Rakshasa.
It is too heavy for ordinary people, but it can be easily wielded by the ghost's strange power.
A powerful blow is enough to shatter the earth, and the impenetrable defense is like an unbreakable city.
description.魔族の少女リエラが愛用する、魔法銃。\n放たれる魔弾は広範囲を支配し、甚大な被害:
The magic gun loved by the demon girl Liela.
The magic bullets fired will sweep across a wide area and cause huge damage.
Magic bullets are infused with charm spells that can control the enemy's mind.
description.ホウライの伝統を継ぐ、散華の如き刃文を持つ太刀。\n千本桜を舞わせる一閃は、視界:
Inheriting the Horai tradition, this sword has a blade pattern that resembles falling cherry blossoms.
The flash that sends Senbonzakura flying can cut off everything in sight in an instant.
The beautiful yet cruel sword light will dye the battlefield into cherry color.
description.ホノカが作成した対水棲モンスター用の武器の１つ。\nクルルが愛用し、戦闘時にはそ:
One of the weapons Honoka made to deal with aquatic monsters.
Kururu loves to use it and will take advantage of its amazing elasticity in battle.
Knock enemies away to the other side of the beach.
description.ホノカが作成した対水棲モンスター用の武器の１つ。\n弓型の高水圧の水鉄砲で、\n:
One of the weapons Honoka made to deal with aquatic monsters.
This is a bow-shaped high-pressure water gun.
It is also a long-range weapon that can launch a variety of attacks and is Nina's favorite.
